minutes.headline: Personnel Committee held off voting on a seasonal heavy equipment operator job description and sent HR a standard question checklist.
minutes.summary: The committee read in full the intermittent heavy equipment operator (DPW, grade nine, seasonal) job description and decided not to vote until HR answers questions. They drafted a standard checklist of questions for HR to answer with future job description submissions. A member reversed his resignation to stay until a replacement is found, and the committee asked residents to apply, since it needs three members to do business.

decisions.decision: The committee would not vote on the heavy equipment operator job description that night and would send questions to HR first.

The job description goes on the next agenda, unless HR needs an answer sooner, in which case a quick meeting and vote would be held.

Future requests to HR will carry a requested-by date.
The committee will encourage residents to submit town board forms to join the committee, which can hold five members and needs three for business.
